summary: Plan to publish the app to Google Play Store and add Firebase authentication (Google, Microsoft/Outlook, phone number) plus a username/password sign-up flow.

existing_features.title: Update the Google Play Store publishing documentation to provide a complete, step-by-step workflow for shipping the existing web app as an Android app using a Trusted Web Activity (Bubblewrap), including required Android build artifacts (package name, signing key guidance, app icon/manifest checks), Digital Asset Links verification, and Play Console release steps, using the production domain referenced in the repository documentation.

Add an in-app “Authentication” help section/screen that clearly explains which login methods are supported in this Internet Computer app build (Internet Identity), and explicitly states that Firebase authentication options (Google, Microsoft/Outlook, phone OTP, and email/password) are not available in this platform environment.

new_feature_requests.summary: Publish the app to the Google Play Store (Android release packaging, listing, and deployment workflow).
Integrate Firebase Authentication with Google sign-in.
Integrate Firebase Authentication with Microsoft (Outlook) sign-in.
Integrate Firebase Authentication with phone number (OTP) sign-in.
Create a sign-up/login page supporting user ID (email/username) and password using Firebase Authentication.
